_comment: The personal-record rule, as cases both apps must agree on: api/tests/test_records.py and android RecordsTest.kt. Hand-written: this file is the specification. `before` is every earlier working set of the exercise as [weight_kg, reps]; `set` is the one just logged. e1RM is Epley, weight × (1 + reps / 30), for 1–12 reps, rounded to 2 places: the same formula as v_sets_enriched.

cases.name: a first set is not a record: there is nothing to beat
heavier than ever, and so a better estimated 1RM
more reps at the same weight: a rep record and a better 1RM
reps count against anything at that weight or heavier
a lighter set with more reps can still be the best 1RM
no rep record at a weight never lifted before; the weight record says it
past twelve reps there is no 1RM estimate, but reps still count
bodyweight after weighted sets: the weighted ones count as heavier
